facts.value: Unconditionally forwards the supplied Fighter_GObj and FtMotionId to Fighter_ChangeMotionState with Ft_MF_None, animation start 0.0f, speed 1.0f, blend argument 0.0f, and NULL alternate animation source, then calls ftAnim_8006EBA4. It validates neither eligibility nor the motion ID. Where the receiver initializes the selected animation, zero blend selects its animation-data default rather than guaranteeing zero effective blend duration.
facts.rationale: Confirms and refines the librarian correction with the receiver's conditional animation-initialization branch.

evidence.why: Complete entry helper and exact arguments.
Conditional initialization and zero/default versus -1/no-blend selection.

facts.value: Traverses HSD_GObj_Entities->fighters in next-link order, overwrites only the visited prefix of ecb_offset_arr and ft_pos_arr, then sets count. Empty input sets count=0 without clearing arrays; stale tails and other fields remain untouched. Source arrays each have eleven elements, but the producer has no capacity check. The head-item caller refreshes Item_804A0CCC then clears x154.b0; the overlap consumer skips the snapshot when that bit equals 1.
facts.rationale: Repairs full-overwrite wording without asserting compiled layout or a global capacity invariant.

evidence.why: Indexed writes, termination, count, and missing bounds guard.
Consumer flag gate and count-bounded use.

facts.value: Supports grounded item-versus-fighter body-overlap resolution by supplying positions and fixed ECB offsets. The item consumer tests ECB overlap and, on success, assigns a horizontal nudge and ORs item xDC0 with mask 1, setting zero-based bit 0. Multiple overlaps can replace the nudge rather than accumulate it.
facts.rationale: Retains the supported mechanic while explicitly repairing the baseline rationale's ambiguous bit numbering.

evidence.why: Overlap loop assigns nudge and uses xDC0 |= 1.
